definition: Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements are U.S. professional standards governing engagements in which practitioners examine, review, or perform agreed procedures on specified subject matter or assertions.
entry_text: Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements are U.S. professional standards governing engagements in which practitioners examine, review, or perform agreed procedures on specified subject matter or assertions.
example: An accounting firm identifies the applicable guidance before accepting an agreed-upon procedures engagement.
label: Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements
